newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Gulf jet fuel diffs rebound from recent slide.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Gulf jet fuel diffs rebound from recent slide.

text.p: U.S. Gulf jet fuel differentials firmed Thursday, regaining ground lost in the past two days, traders said.
"The market was a struggle today, and it looks like the long side won," one player said.
Gulf prompt 54-grade jet fuel changed hands at 0.60 cents under the June NYMEX, more than 0.60 cent stronger than levels talked late Wednesday.
Prompt 55-grade jet fuel in the Gulf lagged behind the gains in the 54-grade material, traders said, with barrels talked about 0.10 cent over the lower grade.
New York Harbor jet fuel differentials were mostly steady with levels seen on Wednesday.
In the NYMEX, June heating oil gained 0.25 cent to settle at 57.80 cents a gallon.
